Battle for the Lehigh Valley: Can GOP hold its razor-thin margin?

Both parties target the Lehigh Valley for House control. While the GOP made inroads with Latinos, Dems argue Trump's immigration stance hurts them. Can Republicans hold this 1% margin swing seat?
